title: German Braised Swede Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting German-inspired casserole featuring slow-cooked swede, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: In a large pan, heat some oil over medium heat. Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add sliced swede, beef broth, mustard, bay leaves, and a pinch of nutmeg. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the swede is tender and the liquid has thickened.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
